prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing desktop workspace and animating pet behaviors..."]
1: ["Set Your Pet's Daily Routine", "Choose when your pet wakes up and goes to sleep on your desktop workspace.", "Complete Setup"]
2: ["Quick tip: Look for your pet icon in the desktop system tray to access quick controls."]
3: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to easily show, hide, and interact with your new desktop companion.", "Got It!"]
4: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Companion", "Select standard adoption or craft a custom pet from photos."]
5: ["Find Your Ideal Desktop Pet", "Answer 3 quick questions to discover whether a starter pet or custom pet fits you best.", "Start Quiz"]
6: ["Configure Pet Desktop Memories", "Pick how your pet reacts to desktop windows and mouse movements.", "Save Reaction"]
7: ["Discover Desktop Pet Capabilities", "See how your companion moves across apps, reacts to your mouse, and stays active in your desktop tray.", "Explore Creation Paths"]
8: ["Your desktop pet choice is linked to your account so you never lose your companion profile."]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Look for the pet icon in your system tray anytime to open controls, change settings, or hide your companion.", "Start Interacting"]
